questions.question_text: Read the unseen passage about the ancient art of pottery. According to the text, what is the most crucial step before the clay is shaped on the potter's wheel?
options: B) Kneading the clay to remove air bubbles
C) Baking the clay in a high-temperature kiln
D) Selling the finished pots in the market
questions.answer: B) Kneading the clay to remove air bubbles

questions.question_text: In the passage, the word 'fragile' is used to describe the unbaked pots. Which of the following is the closest synonym for 'fragile'?
questions.answer: B) Delicate

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank based on the text: The potter uses a special oven called a __________ to harden the shaped clay into durable ceramics.
questions.answer: C) kiln

questions.question_text: Based on the passage, why does the master potter insist that his apprentices practice making simple bowls before attempting tall vases? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The master potter insists on this because simple bowls help apprentices master centering the clay and controlling their hand pressure before handling complex, taller shapes.

questions.question_text: What changes occur to the clay pots when they are subjected to the extreme heat of the firing process? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: During the firing process, the extreme heat chemically alters the clay, removing all moisture and transforming the fragile, dried mud into a solid, waterproof ceramic.

questions.question_text: According to the concluding paragraph, how does pottery teach a person the value of patience? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Pottery requires patience because rushing any step, whether it is drying, shaping, or firing, will cause the clay to crack and ruin the final piece.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Identify the type of sentence: 'Please pass me the English dictionary from the top shelf.'
questions.answer: C) Imperative

questions.question_text: Identify the abstract noun in the following sentence: 'The soldiers were awarded medals for their exceptional bravery on the battlefield.'
questions.answer: D) bravery

questions.question_text: Choose the correct relative pronoun to complete the sentence: 'The girl ________ won the first prize in the debate competition is my cousin.'
questions.answer: D) who

questions.question_text: Select the correct adjective form to complete the comparison: 'Of all the planets in our solar system, Jupiter is the ________.'
questions.answer: C) largest

questions.question_text: Choose the correct sequence of articles to fill the blanks: 'I saw ________ eagle flying over ________ mountain.'
questions.answer: B) an, the

questions.question_text: Identify the correct verb tense in the sentence: 'By the time we reached the station, the train had already left.'
questions.answer: C) Past Perfect

questions.question_text: Rewrite the given sentence by changing the underlined verb into the Present Continuous tense: 'She (writes) a letter to her grandmother.'
options: A) She is writing a letter to her grandmother.
B) She was writing a letter to her grandmother.
C) She has written a letter to her grandmother.
D) She will be writing a letter to her grandmother.
questions.answer: A) She is writing a letter to her grandmother.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb in brackets: 'If it rains tomorrow, we ________ (cancel) the picnic.'
questions.answer: B) will cancel

questions.question_text: Write a descriptive paragraph about your favorite season of the year, highlighting why you enjoy it. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: My favorite season is winter because of the crisp, chilly mornings and the cozy evenings. I love wearing warm sweaters and drinking hot cocoa while reading a good book. The landscape looks beautiful covered in mist, and the pleasant weather allows for enjoyable outdoor bonfires with family and friends.

questions.question_text: Write a short letter to your younger sibling advising them on the importance of reading books regularly outside of their school syllabus. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Dear Rohan, I hope you are doing well. I am writing to remind you how important it is to read storybooks and encyclopedias outside your school syllabus. Reading will improve your vocabulary, expand your imagination, and help you understand the world better. Make it a daily habit. Lots of love, Your elder brother.

questions.question_text: Read the extract from 'Paper Boats': 'Day by day I float my paper boats one by one down the running stream.' What does the poet write on the boats?
options: A) His name and the name of his village
B) A poem about the river
C) A secret message for a friend
D) The date and time of the day
questions.answer: A) His name and the name of his village

questions.question_text: In the lesson 'Animals Birds and Dr Dolittle', why was the Doctor's house so special?
options: A) It was made entirely of glass
B) It was built on top of a large tree
C) It was filled with various kinds of animals living inside
D) It floated on the river
questions.answer: C) It was filled with various kinds of animals living inside

questions.question_text: In the story 'The Day the River Spoke', why did Janu have to initially give up her dream of going to school? [25-35 words]
questions.answer: Janu had to give up her dream because her father believed girls did not need education and wanted her to stay home to take care of her younger siblings and do household chores.

questions.question_text: According to the essay 'Three Days to See', what is Helen Keller's greatest desire on her hypothetical first day of sight? [25-35 words]
questions.answer: On her first day of sight, Helen Keller desperately wants to see the faces of her dear friends, especially her teacher, Mrs. Anne Sullivan, who opened the outer world to her.

questions.question_text: In 'My Brother's Great Invention', what exactly was the invention and what problem was it supposed to solve? [25-35 words]
questions.answer: The brother invented a special pair of mechanical shoes with springs attached to the soles. They were designed to help people jump over tall obstacles and travel to school much faster.

questions.question_text: What is the central message of the poem 'Try Again' when dealing with a difficult task? [25-35 words]
questions.answer: The central message is that one should not easily lose heart after a failure. Instead of feeling disgraced, a person should gather courage, persevere, and try again until they achieve success.

questions.question_text: Analyze the character of Dr. Dolittle. How does his deep affection for animals change the course of his professional life and social standing? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Dr. Dolittle is a deeply compassionate man whose love for animals gradually ruins his human medical practice. As he keeps more animals, his human patients stop visiting. However, guided by his parrot Polynesia, he learns animal languages, transforming into a highly successful and beloved animal doctor who prefers their company over humans.

questions.question_text: In 'The Day the River Spoke', the river serves as a metaphor for Janu's inner voice and motivation. Explain how the river influences Janu to take a bold step toward her education. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The river symbolizes constant movement, freedom, and overcoming obstacles. Watching its unstoppable flow inspires Janu to stop feeling helpless about her situation. The imaginary voice of the river encourages her to secretly attend school by listening outside the classroom window, giving her the courage to break societal barriers and pursue learning.
